profile.headline: 💻🌎💧 Sr. Software Engineer / Water Resources Engineer @ WSP
profile.summary: Full-stack developer, licensed civil engineer, and GIS nerd.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Frontend & backend web development, devops, and even a little big data. At HumanGeo / DigitalGlobe / Radiant Solutions / Maxar I worked on a wide variety of projects typically involving modern web interfaces, REST services (including microservices), databases of many stripes, continuous integration systems, and automated configuration management. Most importantly, I learned how to continuously learn new technologies by diving in head-first.

positions.title: Water Resources Engineer
positions.description: Developed engineering, GIS, and programming skills. Presented at professional conferences, authored key sections for major proposal wins, collaborated directly with federal, state, and local clients, and passed the PE exam. Built Python tools to improve existing GIS workflows and hydrologic/hydraulic modeling workflows for FEMA floodplain mapping projects, and created software to help MS4 clients comply with the Chesapeake Bay TMDL.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Contributed to stream restoration projects. Revised CAD plans at the direction of senior engineers, developed construction cost estimates, and performed field monitoring tasks at stream restoration sites.

publications.title: Evaluation of the SpatioTemporal Asset Catalog for management and discovery of FAIR flood hazard models
